name: SSH brute force then success
explain: Three or more failures from one source followed by a success.

name: SSH password spray
explain: Ten or more failed login attempts from a single source.

name: Port probe scan
explain: Five or more connection refusions or probes within one minute.

name: SQL injection: UNION SELECT
explain: Union-based database exfiltration attempt in query string.

name: SQL injection: tautology bypass
explain: Authentication bypass pattern ' OR '1'='1 in query parameter.

name: SQL injection: comment terminator
explain: SQL comment terminator injected into query.

name: Directory traversal attack
explain: Two or more consecutive parent directory traversal segments (../).

name: Cross-site scripting: script tag
explain: Direct script element tag injection into query string.

name: Cross-site scripting: onerror attribute
explain: Inline error handler payload injection into query string.

name: Automated security scanner user-agent
explain: Known offensive scanning utility identified in HTTP User-Agent header.
